verification_scope: Homepage poses checked against commit 76c9da5690e89a7816bb4b44eefacbcc87521446. The avatar illustration matches the artist's Pixiv publication. Permission status is recorded per asset.
scope: Only Ema’s five homepage poses were restored at the site owner’s explicit request on 2026-11-14. The two portraits later restored for the About pages are recorded in /characters/ASSETS.json. The owner avatar is a separate crop following the circle marked by the owner on 2026-11-27. Third-party media are excluded from the repository software license.
non_ai_processing: The five restored poses retain their original bytes, dimensions and alpha. The avatar uses the crop, resize and encoding recorded below. No generative AI was used to process these files.

assets.source_status: Matched the owner's marked attachment against the illustrator's original Pixiv post, dated 2025-10-24. The crop uses the unmarked 865 × 1200 px Pixiv rendition.
assets.rights_notice: Artwork rights belong to 游亜. Character rights belong to Acacia.

assets.processing: Reuse the approved crop from the unmarked Pixiv rendition. Mask the checkerboard by matching its repeating tiles, preserve the white outline and handwritten text, apply the circular crop, and downscale with Lanczos3. WebP quality 90, alpha quality 100.
